assertions.text: Actual Claude429 then400 produced a stale rate-limit slot suspension before repair; regression and corrected native probe distinguish this defect.

Require terminal api_error_status429 to retain a previous429 candidate. Missing or different terminal status clears. Timeout retains last observed retry. No text guessing, replay or automatic health recovery.

Preserve earlier429 for all terminal API errors
Classify free-text errors or change all harness parsers

residual_risk: No claim of provider capacity or task acceptance. Older native results without final HTTP status are unclassified. Rhumb restart remains pending idle.
